notes.title: TOP QOL
notes.notes:
Very big update to improve players' quality of life, on the menu? 

Well, I'm warning you: the next major update is really big. Here's the program:

-Small particles that indicate what certain slimes do so it's clear

-Small changes to the position of items for the interface

-The new spell 

-Balancing for a little less chaos (but really a little less)

-A color code in the slimedex to know which slimes you can get in the eggs

-Scroll with the wheel in the pokédex!

Looking forward to seeing you!

notes.title: NEW SLIMEDEX
notes.notes:
Hi there! Today's big maj.

A BRAND-NEW SLIMEDEX!
-A custom mouse
-A few fixes too.

Clearly the most important thing is the slimedex, which took me a long time to make! Hope you like it.

notes.title: Regular Update
notes.notes:
Well, we've got some new slimes.

-9 new Slimes, including the final evolutions of the 3 starters (water, fire, plant)
-A BIG FIX because I'd forgotten a lot of the slimes that give spawn scores
-And some minor fixes

And there you have it

Among the slimes that have been added 6 of them are made in reference to certain people, but also to French manga characters, I hope you'll have fun finding them :) 

Have a nice day.


Don't hesitate to join the discord! 

https://discord.gg/adt4bp73gS

notes.title: little fix
notes.notes: Fixing an error in the slimedex

notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE
notes.notes:
-11 new slimes, including 1 secret, all with a Halloween theme
-1 new shiny slime! 
You can save in the in-game options to come back later! 

Have fun!

notes.title: FIX + FIRST SHINY
notes.notes:
Fix: 
-Text that should have been displayed in French was displayed in English 
Double-click to validate the end of the game instead of a single click (avoids mistaken clicks).
-Slime souls reset to 0 at the start of the game.


Added:
-The first shiny slime! This is the basic one, with a 0.1% chance of getting it every time you create one. 
-It can merge with other basic slimes, but won't give a shiny.
-Once unlocked, click on the basic slime in the slimedex to display it instead.

notes.title: TUTORIAL + BUG FIXES
notes.notes:
Hi! This is a quick update before the Halloween update with some spooky slimes.

On the menu: 
-Objects on which you place your mouse are highlighted for better visibility
-The second Slimedex page works correctly.
-Correction of visual bugs where some slimes were not visible.
You can go to the in-game options
-When you used to put slimes on sacrifice and then on sale or vice versa, the info would appear one on top of the other, now it doesn't (yay!)
-There are little arrows to change page on the SLIMEDEX! 
And best of all: there's a tutorial :) 

I'm very happy with the update, so thanks for playing along, and don't hesitate to leave a positive review :)

notes.title: MAJ RPG
notes.notes:
-17 new slimes including 2 secrets
-The eggs are progressive, as long as you have not unlocked a slime it will not appear in the eggs.

Hint for one of the secret slimes: [strike]right-click[/strike]

I advise you to delete your save to take full advantage of the update :)

notes.title: Fix (READ ME)
notes.notes:
Fix language selection 

-Texts no longer overlap, and languages remain.

If this doesn't work, delete the game from your files, uninstall it and reinstall it!
